name: Tieta
description: Inspired on Jorge Amado's romance "Tieta do Agreste", the plot is set on the fictional city of Santana do Agreste, at Brazil's northwest, and has as main theme Tieta's life turnarounds. Twenty-five years after being chased out of town by her father Zé Esteves, she returns to her home town seeking revenge against everyone who mistreated her and laugh at her face in the past.

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: Ascânio arrives in Santana do Agreste. Amintas, Osnar and Timóteo tell him what happened to Tieta: how she initiated in love, the spanking she took from her father and how she left.

videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: Ascânio decides to stay in Santana do Agreste and takes Helena with him. A year goes by. Timóteo uses Tieta's check to pay off his debt at the bank, but Perpétua finds out.

videos.title: Chapters 3 & 4
videos.overview: Ascânio proposes to Artur and Modesto to help him with the tourist complex. Perpétua and Tonha fight over Timóteo's debt. Letícia and Carol arrive in Santana.

videos.title: Chapter 5
videos.overview: The priest wants Perpétua to forgive Timóteo. Helena wishes to return to Rio with Ascânio. Elisa asks Osnar to help Timóteo. Colonel Arthur buys another girl for his collection.

videos.title: Chapter 6
videos.overview: Terto doesn't let Carol buy anything at his store. Helena has a crying spell over dinner and confesses to Ascânio that she is pregnant.

videos.title: Chapter 7
videos.overview: Helena leaves and Ascânio is devastated. Imaculada refuses to eat and is grounded. Carol runs into Modesto's wife and daughter in the square. Ascânio decides to go after his wife.

videos.title: Chapter 8
videos.overview: Perpétua wants Timóteo to sign a promissory note. He flees into the woods and sees the Woman in White. Pirica gives Carol a fish. Osnar pays Timóteo's debt.

videos.title: Chapter 9
videos.overview: Osnar gives Timóteo the money for his next month's debt. Ascânio finds out where Helena is. Carol and Osnar meet on the beach. Perpétua receives a telegram from her son Ricardo.

videos.title: Chapter 10
videos.overview: Ascânio asks Helena for a divorce. Osnar takes food to Carol. Filó leaves the door open and Imaculada runs away. Ricardo, Cosme and Ascânio arrive at Esplanada.

videos.title: Chapter 11
videos.overview: The priest forces Perpétua to authorize Terto to sell to Carol. Peto steals Ricardo's cassock. Imaculada is distracted looking at Ricardo naked and Trapizomba catches her.

videos.title: Chapter 12
videos.overview: The girls from the brothel try to grab Ricardo. Cinira gossips about Carmosina and Osnar for Perpétua. The hydroelectric plant warns that it will not send light to Santana do Agreste. Laura is attacked.

videos.title: Chapter 13
videos.overview: Laura believes that she was attacked by a being from another planet. Elisa dreams of Tarcísio Meira. Dário and Laura tell what she saw to everyone in the city. The extraterrestrial observes Bafo de Bode.

videos.title: Chapter 14
videos.overview: Osnar visits Carol and they kiss. Elisa tries to seduce her husband, but he complains about his stomach. Aída tells Modesto that Perpétua wanted to tell him something about Carol. Elisa disappears.

videos.title: Chapter 15
videos.overview: Perpétua calls everyone to look for Elisa. Modesto waits for Perpétua and discovers the box she keeps in the closet. Tonha meets Elisa. Tieta's check is not enough.

videos.title: Chapter 16
videos.overview: Perpétua accuses Timóteo of having embezzled Tieta's check to pay the bank's promissory note. Everyone sends letters to Tieta asking for news. Perpétua says that the sister died and can prove it.

videos.title: Chapter 17
videos.overview: Perpétua shows everyone proof of her sister's death. The priest agrees to say a mass for Tieta. The colonel marks the first class for Immaculada.

videos.title: Chapter 18
videos.overview: Tonha tells Zé Esteves that Tieta is going to discover all the lies they told. Imaculada gets sick. Ascânio is charmed by Leonora. Tieta tells Carmosina that she came back to take revenge.

videos.title: Chapter 19
videos.overview: Leonora and Ascânio talk for the first time. Filó thinks Immaculada is going to die. Timóteo and Elisa lie to Tieta about their son. Ricardo supports Tieta, preventing her from falling.

videos.title: Chapter 20
videos.overview: Laura sees Osnar leaving Carol's house. Tieta tells the colonel that he wants to buy Imaculada. Carmosina tells Tieta all the lies of Zé Esteves, Perpétua and Elisa.

videos.title: Chapter 21
videos.overview: Tieta faces her father. Carol meets Modesto's family. Perpétua asks Ricardo to do whatever his aunt wants. Tieta, Leonora, Ricardo, Peto and Cosme go for a walk in the Mangue Seco.

videos.title: Chapter 22
videos.overview: Tieta slaps Leonora because of the letter the girl received. Zuleika tells the priest that he wants to help with the feast. Tieta announces that he is going to buy the vacant land in Mangue Seco.

videos.title: Chapter 23
videos.overview: Tieta argues with Osnar over the Mangue Seco. Carol asks Osnar to find out who wrote to Aída. The colonel tells Modesto that he will buy the land before Tieta.

videos.title: Chapter 24
videos.overview: The priest accepts Zuleika's contribution. Aída tries to read the letter she received, but Modesto pretends to have an attack. Leonora asks Tieta to help Ascânio in the matter of light.

videos.title: Chapter 25
videos.overview: Aída is in shock after reading the letter. Ascânio has dinner with Leonora. Ricardo confesses to the priest that he is in doubt about his vocation and tells Tieta that he will leave the seminary.

videos.title: Chapter 26
videos.overview: Tieta offers his support to Ricardo. Leticia visits Carol. Aida receives another letter. Ascânio signs the divorce papers. Tonha wears the clothes that Tieta gave her and Zé Esteves is angry.

videos.title: Chapter 27
videos.overview: Zé Esteves rips Tonha's clothes. Ascânio beats the driver who harasses Leonora and tells her that her skirt is indecent. Carmosina gets drunk, rips Osnar's shirt and calls him immoral.

videos.title: Chapter 28
videos.overview: Carmosina says she is ashamed. Leonora ends her friendship with Ascânio. Osnar tells Carol that he feels like a scoundrel. Jairo looks for Carmosina, who has not returned home. Marcolino is attacked.

videos.title: Chapter 29
videos.overview: Marcolino is found lying on the ground, bewildered and says he was attacked by the Woman in White. Tieta gives Ricardo a package. Osnar is going to talk to Carmosina.

videos.title: Chapter 30
videos.overview: Tieta tells Carmosina to declare himself to Osnar. The colonel invites Tieta to dinner and she demands the girls' presence. Tieta asks Ricardo to put a cream on his back.

videos.title: Chapter 31
videos.overview: Tieta confesses to Leonora what she feels for her nephew. Ricardo tells Perpétua that he is going back to the seminar. Pirica tells Dário and Laura that the fishermen saw a flying saucer.

videos.title: Chapter 32
videos.overview: Elisa reveals to Timóteo that she wants to go to São Paulo with Tieta. Bafo de Bode sees a strange being on the beach. Tieta, Leonora and Ricardo go to dinner at the colonel's house.

videos.title: Chapter 33
videos.overview: The colonel fights with Immaculada and Tieta helps her. Osnar kisses Carol, but she tells him that they can only be friends. Dário and Laura find a man sleeping in their bed.

videos.title: Chapter 34
videos.overview: Dário discovers that Bafo de Bode was fleeing from the Martians. Tieta tells Leonora that she is afraid of hurting Ricardo. Zé Esteves asks Tieta to buy goats for him.

videos.title: Chapter 35
videos.overview: Tieta refuses to buy the goats and Zé Esteves is sick. Marcolino tells everyone that he saw marks in the sand that cannot be human. Ricardo tells Tieta that she did wrong with her father.

videos.title: Chapter 36
videos.overview: Tieta fights with Ricardo. Modesto ties Carol to the foot of the table. Two men arrive in the city looking for Tieta to fulfill his request to supply electricity.

videos.title: Chapter 37
videos.overview: Dário discusses with Ascânio about the arrival of light. Elisa accuses Timóteo of not wanting her happiness. Perpétua realizes that Tieta is upset because of Ricardo. Ascânio seeks Leonora.

videos.title: Chapter 38
videos.overview: Ascânio and Leonora argue. Dário tells Laura that he will not be able to continue his search if the light arrives. Ricardo and Tieta do not speak. Tieta calls Tonha and Zé Esteves to talk.

videos.title: Chapter 39
videos.overview: Tieta says she is going to buy a house for her father and Tonha. Osnar breaks into Carol's door and sees her tied up. The colonel calls Imaculada for the first lesson. Tieta asks Ricardo to forgive her.

videos.title: Chapter 40
videos.overview: Ascânio finds it strange that Helena did not send confirmation of the divorce hearing. Perpetual catches Amorzinho talking to Amintas. Tieta calls Ascânio for dinner at Dário's house.

videos.title: Chapter 41
videos.overview: At Dário's house, Tieta pretends to be sick and tells Ascânio and Leonora to walk alone. They are reconciled, but the tide is rising and they cannot leave the island where they are.

videos.title: Chapter 42
videos.overview: Leonora and Ascânio realize that Tieta set everything up. Elisa calls Helena to sleep at her house. Tieta and Ricardo see the moonlight together. Helena will find Ascânio at the anchorage.

videos.title: Chapter 43
videos.overview: Helena tells Ascânio that she regretted it and he takes her home. Tieta tells Leonora where Helena is. Elisa takes Leonora to talk to Helena.

videos.title: Chapter 44
videos.overview: Helena threatens Leonora and orders her to give up on Ascânio. Cosme asks Ricardo to leave, but he refuses. Ascânio looks for Leonora and says he wants to continue with the friendship.

videos.title: Chapter 45
videos.overview: Tieta approves the blueprint for his new home. Elisa tells Timóteo that if they don't make love, she'll do it with someone else. Laura sees in the book of Dário the being that was on the beach.

videos.title: Chapter 46
videos.overview: Dário says that Laura saw a diver's outfit. Tieta talks to Leonora about Ricardo and decides to leave. Tieta communicates his decision to his nephew, but he goes after her.

videos.title: Chapter 47
videos.overview: Tieta warns that she will say goodbye to Mangue Seco before leaving. Ricardo tells Cosme that he can't stop thinking about his aunt. Perpétua asks Ricardo to convince Tieta to stay.

videos.title: Chapter 48
videos.overview: Helena demands that Leonora move away from her husband. The colonel asks Ascânio to find Arthur. Ricardo tells Tieta that he will stay with her until she leaves.

videos.title: Chapter 49
videos.overview: Perpétua and Cosme argue because of Ricardo. Timóteo hears Elisa say that she wanted to be like Helena and threatens to beat her. Ricardo runs after Tieta in the dunes.

videos.title: Chapter 50
videos.overview: Jairo tells Ascânio that the posts are being installed. The colonel talks about Arturzinho without feeling ill. Cosme gets sick. Ricardo asks Tieta if she is still leaving.

videos.title: Chapter 51
videos.overview: Helena begs Ascânio to come back to her. Ricardo asks Tieta to marry him. Jairo warns that they are paving the road. Ascânio almost kisses Helena, but Carmosina interrupts.

videos.title: Chapter 52
videos.overview: Helena and Carmosina fight. Modesto disguises himself to go to the cabaret. Zé Esteves feels dizzy. Silvana's car breaks down on the road. Tieta tells Ricardo that he gave up leaving.

videos.title: Chapter 53
videos.overview: Elisa smells a woman's perfume in Timóteo. Zuleika, dressed as the Woman in White, frightens Modesto. He summons some men and leaves with a gun in search of the apparition.

videos.title: Chapter 54
videos.overview: Ascânio and Helena sleep together. Elisa sees a lipstick mark on Timóteo's chest. Tonha remembers Arturzinho. Silvana looks for Dário. Carol tells Modesto that she wants Junior with her.

videos.title: Chapter 55
videos.overview: Ascânio tells his friends that he reconciled with Helena. Leonora finds out and cries. Tonha tells Timóteo that she believes in him. Carmosina talks about Helena's letter to Leonora.

videos.title: Chapter 56
videos.overview: Leonora refuses to read the letter. The colonel calls Immaculada for the lesson, but Filó says the girl is busy telling a story. Tieta advises Carmosina to unmask Helena.

videos.title: Chapter 57
videos.overview: Carmosina hands the letter to Ascânio. Helena fights with Rafa. Osnar, Timóteo and Chalita think that Dário is hiding something. Elisa asks Tieta to take her from Santana.

videos.title: Chapter 58
videos.overview: The priest tells Ricardo that he needs to hear his confession. Rafa leaves. Silvana wants to learn to dive with Dário. Ascânio reads the letter and is perplexed.

videos.title: Chapter 59
videos.overview: Helena tries to argue, but Ascânio sends her away. Helena can't find a place to spend the night. Tieta feels sorry and asks Carmosina to accept Helena in the pension.

videos.title: Chapter 60
videos.overview: Elisa makes peace with Timóteo. Helena tells Ascânio that Carmosina may have written the letter. The priest wants Tieta to convince Ricardo to confess. Leonora seeks Ascânio.

videos.title: Chapter 61
videos.overview: Leonora offers her friendship to Ascânio. Cinira sees Amintas leaving Amorzinho's house. Silvana wants to help Dário. Ricardo confesses to the priest that he sinned against chastity.

videos.title: Chapter 62
videos.overview: Tieta warns that she will give Tonha only a few shares and Timóteo some money and a trip to São Paulo. Zé Esteves is angry and sick. Rosalvo and Bebê arrive in Santana.

videos.title: Chapter 63
videos.overview: Bebê shows interest in Osnar. Elisa meets Rosalvo and gets excited. Dário remembers that he saw Bebê among the divers. Tieta wants to find out what outsiders want.

videos.title: Chapter 64
videos.overview: Bebê is delighted with Osnar's serenade. Leonora and Ascânio kiss. Bebê and Osnar date under a ravine on the beach and Carol accidentally falls on top of them.

videos.title: Chapter 65
videos.overview: Carol is disillusioned with Osnar and Bebê is irritated by the situation. The Woman in White attacks Rosalvo. Osnar and Carol spend the night together. Aída tells Modesto that Osnar is Carol's boyfriend.

videos.title: Chapter 66
videos.overview: Carol tells Osnar that what happened cannot be repeated. Modesto suspects both of them and leaves Carol tied to the table again. Ascânio declares himself to Leonora.

videos.title: Chapter 67
videos.overview: Dário and Laura tell Modesto that they know that Carol is his lover. Elisa pretends to look for Carmosina to find Rosalvo. Timóteo goes to get it and they fight. Tieta seeks Elisa.

videos.title: Chapter 68
videos.overview: Tieta fights with Elisa. Timóteo travels to São Paulo. The people prepare the feast for the arrival of light. A man arrives in Santana in a truck called Ark of Dreams.

videos.title: Chapter 69
videos.overview: Carmosina takes Gladstone to the boardinghouse. In front of Milu, Tieta pretends she doesn't know him, but then asks if everything is right with what she asked for. Imaculada is startled to see Ricardo.

videos.title: Chapter 70
videos.overview: Tieta reveals the plaque in her honor and Perpétua is angry because he does not have the surname Esteves. Imaculada gives up on storytelling. Gladstone opens the truck.

videos.title: Chapter 71
videos.overview: Gladstone tells Carmosina that he wants to make his dreams come true. Sabino and Peto exchange gifts from Timóteo. Ricardo finds Cosme in his room after spending the night with Tieta.

videos.title: Chapter 72
videos.overview: Zé Esteves starts to hallucinate. Silvana goes shopping and Amintas accompanies her. Amorzinho sees and gets jealous. Cosme goes to Tieta's room to check if Ricardo is there.

videos.title: Chapter 73
videos.overview: Perpétua sees no problem with Ricardo being in Tieta's room and fights with Cosme. Araci finds Perpétua's white box. Tonha realizes that there is something strange with Zé Esteves.

videos.title: Chapter 74
videos.overview: The colonel insists that Imaculada tell more stories. She gets angry and breaks several objects. Tieta advises Imaculada. Gladstone gives Milu a television.

videos.title: Chapter 75
videos.overview: Imaculada advises the colonel's girls to revolt. Zé Esteves has another fit of madness and attacks Perpétua. Gladstone warns that he will distribute gifts bought by Tieta.

videos.title: Chapter 76
videos.overview: Tieta tells Carmosina that she gave the gifts just to cause discord. Perpétua wants to know if Tieta forgot about Peto and Ricardo.

videos.title: Chapter 77
videos.overview: Tieta and Perpétua fight. The colonel wants to send Imaculada away. Modesto forbids Carol to befriend Silvana and Laura. Perpétua sees Gladstone kissing Tieta's hand.

videos.title: Chapter 78
videos.overview: Tieta tells Leonora to fight with Ascânio. Perpétua tells Ricardo that she thinks Tieta already knew Gladstone. Filó decides to help Immaculada to escape. Ricardo talks to Tieta about Gladstone.

videos.title: Chapter 79
videos.overview: Ricardo and Tieta fight over Gladstone. Milu wants to send his recipe to a contest. Timóteo tells Perpétua that Chalita will ask him for Amorzinho's hand.

videos.title: Chapter 80
videos.overview: Laura finds Modesto in Carol's closet. Amintas tells Amorzinho of the request. Amorzinho and the priest argue with Perpétua. Ricardo and Tieta fight over Osnar.

videos.title: Chapter 81
videos.overview: Chalita argues with Amintas. Amintas implies that he would not marry Amorzinho. Tieta buys a TV for Elisa. Imaculada runs away.

videos.title: Chapter 82
videos.overview: Ricardo threatens to beat Osnar. Leonora tells Tieta that she won't tell Ascânio the truth. Zé Esteves looks for Tieta, but the colonel arrives at the same time asking for Immaculada.

videos.title: Chapter 83
videos.overview: The colonel tries to look for Immaculata in Gladstone's truck and Carmosina stops him. Tieta says he will do what Zé Esteves wants if he reveals where the money is.

videos.title: Chapter 84
videos.overview: Zé Esteves shows Tieta the money on the mattress. Peto takes Leticia to the church under construction. They kiss and discover Imaculada hidden.

videos.title: Chapter 85
videos.overview: Children seek supplies for Imaculada. Trapizomba kidnaps Gladstone. The colonel says that Gladstone will only leave when he tells where Imaculada is.

videos.title: Chapter 86
videos.overview: Carmosina looks for Gladstone. Peto and Letícia say that Immaculada left. Gladstone is released and leaves promising to return. Perpétua begins the meeting without Tieta and is appointed head of the family.

videos.title: Chapter 87
videos.overview: Perpétua and Tieta fight. Amintas visits Amorzinho. Filó finds out where Imaculada is and goes to see her. Perpétua and Tieta want to know which side Ricardo would be on and fight for his father's staff.

videos.title: Chapter 88
videos.overview: Tieta does not hand over the staff and Perpétua expels her sister. Modesto makes Carol stay in the rain. Rosalvo and Bebê return. Tieta tells Perpétua that Ricardo is now his.

videos.title: Chapter 89
videos.overview: Perpétua insists that Tieta stay. Timóteo meets Elisa with Rosalvo. Aida discovers that Carol is ill and will help. Marcolino tells Modesto who owns Mangue Seco.

videos.title: Chapter 90
videos.overview: Modesto and Marcolino tell the colonel whose beach it is. Rosalvo says that his firm also wants to know. Aida discovers that Carol is a mother. The colonel says that he goes to the church to look for Immaculada.

videos.title: Chapter 91
videos.overview: Tieta sends Ricardo away, but reveals to Carmosina her love for him. Aída asks Osnar to spend the night with Carol. Leonora induces Ascânio to want to ask for your hand. The colonel arrives at the church.

videos.title: Chapter 92
videos.overview: The colonel finds the things that Immaculada left. Peto takes Immaculada hidden to the circus. Gladstone comes back and brings Jairo, who says that the marinete was apprehended.

videos.title: Chapter 93
videos.overview: Tieta tells Leonora that Ascânio will suffer. Perpétua sees Gladstone going to Tieta's house and sends Ricardo over there. Silvana saves Dário at sea and kisses him. Modesto sees Aída with Carol.

videos.title: Chapter 94
videos.overview: Tieta and Ricardo fight and she confesses that she already knew Gladstone. Perpétua tells Tonha that she will never be a woman again. Tourists arrive in Santana. Ricardo cries for Tieta.

videos.title: Chapter 95
videos.overview: Carmosina gives Tieta advice about Ricardo. After drinking, Jairo drives the tourist bus and Cinira gets in front of the vehicle. Timóteo receives a letter saying that he will be betrayed.

videos.title: Chapter 96
videos.overview: Gladstone tells Ricardo that he has nothing to do with Tieta. Ricardo asks Tieta to marry him. Osnar sleeps with Bebê. Timóteo sees Elisa with Rosalvo. The priest and Cosme find Tonha unconscious.

videos.title: Chapter 97
videos.overview: Tieta asks Carmosina to tell Ascânio that Leonora is not a virgin. The family goes to see Tonha, who is ill, and Tieta advises her friend to take care of herself. Ricardo fights with his mother over Tieta.

videos.title: Chapter 98
videos.overview: Amorzinho says yes to Chalita in front of Amintas. Leôncio takes a folder with papers on the factory. Carmosina calls Ascânio to talk about Leonora. Tonha asks Tieta for help.

videos.title: Chapter 99
videos.overview: Tieta wants to send Tonha to São Paulo. Ascânio treats Leonora coldly. Leôncio reveals to Dário that the industry is going to settle in Mangue Seco. Perpetual tells Tonha to move in with her.

videos.title: Chapter 100
videos.overview: Tonha refuses to go with Perpétua, who accuses her of wanting to be quiet. Tonha checks with two slaps. Ascânio asks Leonora why she lied. Tonha tells Tieta that she's going to São Paulo.

videos.title: Chapter 101
videos.overview: Ascânio and Leonora fight. Leonora argues with Tieta and threatens to reveal what she knows. Timóteo receives another letter saying that Elisa betrays him and asks Tieta not to bring Nineteen.

videos.title: Chapter 102
videos.overview: Carol tells Modesto that there is no way to stop Aída from seeing her. Ascânio decides to stay with Leonora. Mirko makes an appointment with Ascânio in Rio. Imaculada appears to Cosme and the priest.

videos.title: Chapter 103
videos.overview: Imaculada accepts to leave the city. Carmosina and Gladstone almost kiss. Juracy leaves a letter at the colonel's house telling him where Imaculada is. Tieta asks Gladstone to steal something.

videos.title: Chapter 104
videos.overview: The colonel finds Imaculada. Ricardo tries to help, but she leaves with the colonel. Tieta takes out life insurance. Immaculata says she will kill herself if she stays with the colonel.

videos.title: Chapter 105
videos.overview: The colonel delivers Imaculada to the Red Light house. Mirko makes the appointment with Ascânio. Tieta tells Leonora that Helena will try to win Ascânio back. He and Leonora spend the night together.

videos.title: Chapter 106
videos.overview: Amintas feels used by Silvana and is furious. Ricardo fights with his mother over Tieta. Gladstone and Osnar play video games competing for a kiss from Carmosina.

videos.title: Chapter 107
videos.overview: Carmosina doesn't kiss Osnar. Tieta asks Tonha what she would do if Arthur returned. Silvana kisses Dário. Cinira finds Amorzinho dressed only in a blouse and panties.

videos.title: Chapter 108
videos.overview: Gladstone almost kisses Carmosina and she slaps him. She apologizes and he gives her a kiss. Gladstone tells Tieta the name of the firm. Elisa tries to open an anonymous letter to Timóteo.

videos.title: Chapter 109
videos.overview: Ascânio travels to Rio. Dário confronts Rosalvo. Carmosina allows Gladstone to hold his hand. Tieta receives Ninete in the square. Osnar and Amintas believe there is something wrong with her.

videos.title: Chapter 110
videos.overview: Tieta introduces Ninete to everyone. The priest goes to the colonel's house to see Immaculada. Carol travels with Aída and Letícia. Ascânio goes to Helena's apartment.

videos.title: Chapter 111
videos.overview: Helena tells Ascânio that the divorce process is slow. Dário asks Gladstone for diving equipment. Ninete goes to Chalita e Amintas's bar to flirt.

videos.title: Chapter 112
videos.overview: Everyone is shocked by Nineteen's revelation. Ricardo fights with Tieta. Leôncio takes Filó home and the colonel sees it. Perpétua says he wants to set the city against Tieta and Ricardo listens to it.

videos.title: Chapter 113
videos.overview: Ricardo and Perpétua fight. Imaculada faces the colonel. Perpétua calls a meeting to expel Ninete. Perpétua comes home and finds Tieta with her white box open.

videos.title: Chapter 114
videos.overview: Tieta threatens Perpetual. Ninete and Tonha travel. Perpétua asks Cinira to leave her tape recorder in Tieta's window. Elisa dreams of Rosalvo and raises sleepwalker.

videos.title: Chapter 115
videos.overview: Ricardo spends the night with Tieta. Timóteo wakes up and looks for Elisa. Ascânio finds that the product is toxic. Perpétua and Cinira listen to the tape. Rosalvo wakes up Elisa and the two fall into the fountain.

videos.title: Chapter 116
videos.overview: Timóteo attacks Rosalvo and Amintas separates them. Ascânio demands to find Mirko. Dário beats Silvana, Laura sees and he tells everything. Perpétua steals the key to Tieta's house. Timóteo expels Elisa.

videos.title: Chapter 117
videos.overview: Elisa tries to talk to Timóteo, but he doesn't believe in the woman and she goes to Perpétua's house. Tieta searches for her, but Elisa says she no longer needs her. Leonora visits Elisa.

videos.title: Chapter 118
videos.overview: The Woman in White attacks Modesto. Tieta and Leonora go to Esplanada. Mirko does not show up for lunch and sends Rosalvo and Bebê. Helena joins them.

videos.title: Chapter 119
videos.overview: In exchange for your help, Helena demands to negotiate with Mirko personally. Silvana apologizes to Laura. The colonel and his henchmen take Imaculada by force.

videos.title: Chapter 120
videos.overview: Carmosina tells Elisa that Leonora tried to promote her reconciliation with Timóteo. Ricardo faces the colonel with a sword, runs away with Immaculada on horseback and takes her to Tieta's house.

videos.title: Chapter 121
videos.overview: Imaculada sees Tieta and Ricardo kissing. Amorzinho has another attack and grabs Timóteo. Tieta asks Milu for help. Elisa and Leonora become friends. The marinete is chased by a helicopter.

videos.title: Chapter 122
videos.overview: Rosalvo gets out of the helicopter and says that Mirko wants to see Ascânio. Milu tells the colonel that his wife killed herself and threatens to reveal the reason.

videos.title: Chapter 123
videos.overview: Arturzinho tells how he became Mirko. Marcolino and Modesto convince the colonel to resume the city hall. Ascânio accepts the factory and Mirko asks him not to reveal his identity.

videos.title: Chapter 124
videos.overview: Helena tells Mirko that Ascânio will be on his side. Perpétua despairs because everyone likes Tieta. Ascânio tells everyone about the factory. Perpétua wants to expel Tieta from the city.

videos.title: Chapter 125
videos.overview: Ascânio proposes a referendum for the city to decide on the factory. The colonel resumes the city hall. Osnar advises Tieta on Perpetua. Modesto faints when he sees Carol with her son.

videos.title: Chapter 126
videos.overview: Tieta reassures Osnar. Dário lets the boys help in the search, but asks for secrecy. Bebê calls Timóteo to talk in his room. Tieta is jealous of Ricardo.

videos.title: Chapter 127
videos.overview: Timóteo takes Bebê to bed. Mirko does not like to know that Ascânio is no longer the mayor. Perpétua enters Tieta's house and discovers Ricardo in his sister's bed.

videos.title: Chapter 128
videos.overview: Perpetual screams that she is blind. Cinira sees Timóteo leaving Bebê's room and tells Amorzinho. Helena tells Mirko that Tieta is a very influential person in Santana.

videos.title: Chapter 129
videos.overview: Perpétua asks Tieta for her father's staff. Amorzinho and Cinira tell Perpétua about Timóteo and Bebé. Rosalvo tells Mirko that Tieta uses a false name and he orders her to investigate.

videos.title: Chapter 130
videos.overview: Perpétua tells Elisa about Timóteo. Everyone agrees with Ascânio on the referendum. Elisa fights with Bebê. Osnar suspects Perpétua and warns Tieta. Elisa invites Rosalvo to dinner.

videos.title: Chapter 131
videos.overview: Bebê tells Timóteo that Elisa and Rosalvo are together. Elisa doesn't let Rosalvo kiss him. Timóteo goes there, but does not find Rosalvo. Tieta wants to investigate Mirko.

videos.title: Chapter 132
videos.overview: After receiving an anonymous letter, Elisa starts to demand half of Timóteo's billing. Rosalvo tells the colonel that Mirko only talks to Ascânio. Perpetual seeks Tieta.

videos.title: Chapter 133
videos.overview: Perpétua demands that Tieta marry Ricardo. Tieta gives money to her sister. Perpétua wants Tieta to adopt her children, but she refuses. Imaculada console Ricardo and Osnar console Tieta.

videos.title: Chapter 134
videos.overview: Ricardo says that he will return to the seminary if his mother does not tell what she saw to anyone else. Tieta shows Perpétua a copy of his will, in which he leaves everything to Peto and Ricardo.

videos.title: Chapter 135
videos.overview: Rosalvo tells the colonel that the factory will be installed elsewhere. Perpétua sends Ricardo back to the seminary. The colonel tells Ascânio that he will let him run the negotiations.

videos.title: Chapter 136
videos.overview: Tieta tells Leonora that she will get revenge on Perpétua. Mirko orders Rosalvo to organize Santana's party. Tieta is suspicious of the factory and asks Leonora if she knows something she does not know.

videos.title: Chapter 137
videos.overview: Dário tells Laura that he is going to ask for Tieta's help in the campaign against the factory. Marcolino, Modesto and the colonel decide that Bafo de Bode will be the owner of Mangue Seco.

videos.title: Chapter 138
videos.overview: Modesto goes to Carol's house. Edmundo overhears his parents talking about Carol and Modesto. Osnar and Tieta play in the sea and Carol sees. Edmundo tells Letícia that Modesto knows Carol.

videos.title: Chapter 139
videos.overview: Osnar goes to Carol's house and argues with Tieta. Modesto does not convince Leticia. Leonora warns that Tonha will be back. Leticia looks for Carol. Tieta and Osnar fight and end up kissing.

videos.title: Chapter 140
videos.overview: Tieta tells Osnar to leave. Letícia reveals to her mother what she discovered. Aída asks Modesto to tell his daughter the truth. Rosalvo kisses Elisa.

videos.title: Chapter 141
videos.overview: Filó tells the colonel that he is thinking of marrying Leôncio. Osnar, Chalita, Amintas and Cinira witness an attack by Amorzinho. Filó is sick. Ascânio invites Leonora to live with him.

videos.title: Chapter 142
videos.overview: Letícia tells her father that she no longer wants to see him. Marcolino is chosen to host Bafo de Bode. Tieta comes home. Leonora moves. Carol looks for Modesto.

videos.title: Chapter 143
videos.overview: Carol advises Modesto to leave the house. Juracy finds Bafo de Bode in his office. Jairo asks Cinira to marry him and she passes out. Modesto tells Aída that she is leaving the house.

videos.title: Chapter 144
videos.overview: Tieta instructs Elisa to treat Timóteo with indifference. Marcolino explains to Bafo de Bode that his name is Possidônio and that he owns Mangue Seco. Modesto goes to Carol's house.

videos.title: Chapter 145
videos.overview: Osnar tells Tieta that he no longer wants to fight. Modesto says goodbye to Carol. Cinira accepts Jairo's request. Tieta speaks of Osnar to Carmosina.

videos.title: Chapter 146
videos.overview: Perpétua and Carmosina fight. Pastor Hilário arrives in the city and Amorzinho asks him to save her. Tonha sees an ultralight falling on the dunes and recognizes Arturzinho as the pilot.

videos.title: Chapter 147
videos.overview: The pastor tries to convert Perpétua. Tonha takes Arturzinho to his father's house. Hilário's men arrest Bafo de Bode. Arturzinho wants to leave before seeing his father, but the colonel arrives.

videos.title: Chapter 148
videos.overview: The colonel orders Arthur to be arrested. Ascânio reveals to Bebo and Rosalvo the identity of Mirko. Bafo de Bode reappears as a shepherd. Perpetual insults Tonha. Arturzinho is sick and passes out.

videos.title: Chapter 149
videos.overview: Mirko asks Ascânio to call his doctor and he lies to the colonel about how he did it. The doctor tells Arturzinho to rest. Bafo de Bode and Hilário face off.

videos.title: Chapter 150
videos.overview: Tieta gives the pastor money to leave the city. Tieta tells Ascânio to tell him everything about Arthur. Everyone goes to the fireworks display. Carmosina and Gladstone spend the night together.

videos.title: Chapter 151
videos.overview: Amintas tries to speak to Amorzinho, but she does not accept his advice. Timóteo asks Elisa to lend her the house for two hours. Chalita asks Tieta to help Amorzinho.

videos.title: Chapter 152
videos.overview: The colonel surprises Filó by leaving home and threatens him. Amorzinho tells Perpétua that he will not obey her blindly. Tonha visits Arturzinho. Gladstone tells Tieta that he did as she was told.

videos.title: Chapter 153
videos.overview: Tieta insists on paying Gladstone for the favor he did to Carmosina. Arturzinho tells Tonha that he hasn't forgotten her. Tieta asks Leonora to tell her what Mirko has to do with Arthur.

videos.title: Chapter 154
videos.overview: Timóteo goes to Mangue Seco to deliver a package to Carol, while Bebê awaits him at his home with Elisa. Timóteo has dinner with Carol and Osnar sees him leaving.

videos.title: Chapter 155
videos.overview: Arturzinho confesses to Tieta that he is Mirko and demands that she tell him why he also changed his surname, but she does not. Elisa asks Timóteo to leave the house free for her and Rosalvo.

videos.title: Chapter 156
videos.overview: Rosalvo and Bebé reveal to Ascânio that Tieta uses a false surname. Arturzinho kisses Tonha. Arturzinho overhears his father talking to Modesto and Marcolino about Bafo de Bode.

videos.title: Chapter 157
videos.overview: Leonora convinces Ascânio that his surname is true. Leonora receives a letter from Francisco. Tieta discovers that Tonha and her brother are the true owners of Mangue Seco.

videos.title: Chapter 158
videos.overview: Francisco sends Leonora to find him. Tieta tells everyone that Tonha is the owner of Mangue Seco. Osnar gets tired of waiting for Tieta for dinner and leaves. Tonha catches Elisa and Rosalvo.

videos.title: Chapter 159
videos.overview: Timóteo tells Tonha that he invited Rosalvo. Osnar tells Carol about Tieta and she sends him away. Tieta gets tired of waiting for Osnar and throws the dinner she has set on the floor.

videos.title: Chapter 160
videos.overview: Sleepwalking, Timóteo sleeps embraced with Elisa. Leonora goes to Esplanada to find Francisco, but Helena is the one who waits for her. She shows him a story that accuses Leonora of being a drug dealer.

videos.title: Chapter 161
videos.overview: Helena says she will only be quiet if Leonora leaves Ascânio. Tieta and Osnar argue, but end up sleeping together. Cosme tells Perpétua that Ricardo has fled the seminary.

videos.title: Chapter 162
videos.overview: Leonora lies to Carmosina. Perpétua goes to Tieta's room to look for Ricardo, but only finds Osnar. Osnar asks Tieta how they will be if Ricardo comes back.

videos.title: Chapter 163
videos.overview: Imaculada tells Leticia that she has an impossible love. Imaculada hears Cinira comment on Ricardo's disappearance with Milu and passes out. Silvana comes back. Leonora tells Ascânio that she will leave him.

videos.title: Chapter 164
videos.overview: Leonora tells Ascânio that she got tired of him. Imaculada offends Perpetual. Silvana visits Laura. Helena arrives and goes to see Ascânio. Leonora returns to Tieta's house.

videos.title: Chapter 165
videos.overview: Tieta offers to tell Ascânio the whole truth. Silvana confesses to Laura that she returned because of Dário. Bebê buys all the dresses made by Aída. Ascânio seeks Leonora.

videos.title: Chapter 166
videos.overview: Laura authorizes Dário to betray her with Silvana. Cora overhears Tieta telling Gladstone that she paid him to sleep with Carmosina. Perpetual listens to Cora comment this to Araci and tells Carmosina.

videos.title: Chapter 167
videos.overview: Mirko sends Helena to the beach house. Ascânio does not agree with the expropriation of Mangue Seco. Bitter, Carmosina thanks Tieta for paying Gladstone to sleep with her.

videos.title: Chapter 168
videos.overview: Tieta is unable to convince her friend that she just wanted to do him good. Osnar convinces Carmosina to listen to Gladstone's explanations. Carmosina and Gladstone meet at Elisa's house.

videos.title: Chapter 169
videos.overview: Gladstone tries to explain himself to Carmosina. After discovering that it was Perpétua who told Carmosina everything, Tieta goes to her sister's house and takes the white box.

videos.title: Chapter 170
videos.overview: Gladstone leaves. Dário invites Silvana to dinner at his house. Manon organizes the party of Zuleika's arrival. Ascânio is fired by the colonel. Leonora and Ascânio meet.

videos.title: Chapter 171
videos.overview: The colonel expropriates Mangue Seco. Bebê tells Aída that her brother wants all of his production. Leonora tells Ascânio that Arturzinho did not travel. Zuleika arrives bringing Ricardo.

videos.title: Chapter 172
videos.overview: Arturzinho spends the night with Tonha. Cinira discovers that Ricardo was in the brothel and tells Perpétua. Perpétua asks Marcolino how he can manage his son's assets.

videos.title: Chapter 173
videos.overview: Aída tells Carol that they will start working at the tannery. Perpétua reveals to Tieta that Ricardo has returned. Ascânio asks Arturzinho why he told his father to expropriate Mangue Seco.

videos.title: Chapter 174
videos.overview: Arturzinho shows Ascânio the story that accuses Leonora of being a drug dealer. Perpétua tells Ricardo that he will sell the house and asks for a power of attorney. Tieta wakes up with Ricardo watching her.

videos.title: Chapter 175
videos.overview: Ricardo and Tieta talk about how they changed. Amorzinho tells Cinira that Carol will make a new wedding dress. Perpetual asks Marcolino if he is entitled to Tonha's inheritance.

videos.title: Chapter 176
videos.overview: Carmosina tells her mother that she wanted to eat the wedding flowers. Timóteo is attacked by the Woman in White. Milu tells her daughter that she is pregnant. Ascânio seeks Leonora.

videos.title: Chapter 177
videos.overview: Arturzinho convinces Perpétua to accept money to give up on Mangue Seco. Ascânio asks Leonora to return to him. Arturzinho asks Tonha to marry him and confesses that he is Mirko.

videos.title: Chapter 178
videos.overview: Milu tells Tieta that Arthur is guilty of his mother's death. Ricardo signs the power of attorney for Perpétua. Tonha will spend a few days at Elisa's house and notice that something is wrong.

videos.title: Chapter 179
videos.overview: Elisa and Timóteo are unable to prevent Tonha from being with them. Silvana is waiting for Dário at her home. Bafo de Bode offends Tonha and Arturzinho hits him with a whip.

videos.title: Chapter 180
videos.overview: Tonha is disappointed with Arturzinho. Tieta accuses Osnar of using Carol. Imaculada tells Ricardo that she loves him. The Woman in White tries to attack Arthur.

videos.title: Chapter 181
videos.overview: Mirko remembers the Woman in White. Tonha promises to help Bafo de Bode if he stops drinking. Dário finds a chest. Perpétua enters Tieta's room and smothers her with a pillow.

videos.title: Chapter 182
videos.overview: Perpétua realizes that she is suffocating Araci. Tieta decides to change the will. Information about Tieta arrives for Mirko. Perpétua tells Tonha about Elisa and Timóteo.

videos.title: Chapter 183
videos.overview: Ascânio and Mirko fight. Dário and Laura reveal to Silvana what is in the chest. Modesto tells Perpétua to apologize to Letícia or he will tell everyone about the white box.

videos.title: Chapter 184
videos.overview: Dário opens the chest and sees that the diary has turned to dust. Dário finds the Woman in White's dress in a canoe. Mirko is told that Helena has run away. Modesto sees Júnior fall into a well.

videos.title: Chapter 185
videos.overview: Ascânio expels Helena from her home. Laura and Dário decide to move and take Silvana. Moraes Moreira and Pepeu Gomes arrive in Santana to make a clip. Mirko calls Leonora Sheila.

videos.title: Chapter 186
videos.overview: Modesto decides to register Junior. Ricardo tells Peto that he likes Immaculada, but is afraid. Jairo and Cinira return, bringing Leôncio and Chalita, who married Doroti.

videos.title: Chapter 187
videos.overview: Leonora tells Ascânio that she is a woman of life. Arturzinho calls Tieta Madame Antoinette from Higienópolis. Ascânio tells the colonel that Arturzinho is Mirko.

videos.title: Chapter 188
videos.overview: Ascânio tells the colonel to take care of his son. Tieta advises Ricardo to treat Imaculada well. Tieta decides to reveal to Tonha the truth about her life.

videos.title: Chapter 189
videos.overview: The colonel expels Arturzinho. Gladstone tells Immaculada that his stories will be published. Perpétua offers Arturzinho his home if he helps to destroy Tieta.

videos.title: Chapter 190
videos.overview: Ricardo doesn't like to know that Imaculada is going to São Paulo. Tonha agrees to sell her land to Brastânio, but Tieta warns that she will claim her share to prevent her friend.

videos.title: Chapter 191
videos.overview: Tieta sends Tonha to tell Arturzinho that she is going to fight with him. The colonel restores Ascânio to the job of the city hall. Ricardo confesses to the Imaculada that he is confused and they kiss.

videos.title: Chapter 192
videos.overview: Tonha tells Tiko about Tieta's decision. Mirko orders Ascânio to expropriate Mangue Seco or he will tell everyone who Leonora is. Leticia forgives her father. Ricardo decides to run for councilor.

videos.title: Chapter 193
videos.overview: Juracy sends Marcolino anonymous letters saying he has a lover. Arturzinho travels. Osnar tells Tieta that he wants to be with her. Ten days later, Arthur returns.

videos.title: Chapter 194
videos.overview: Helena looks for Mirko, who burns her hand with a cigarette. Milu tells the colonel that Arthur is to blame for his mother's death. Perpétua reads the dossier on Tieta.

videos.title: Chapter 195
videos.overview: Perpétua sees the killer leaving the city hall and goes over there. Tieta looks for Mirko at the city hall. Perpétua takes the priest and Osnar to the scene and they find Tieta with the gun.

videos.title: Chapter 196
videos.overview: Elisa tells Timóteo that she is going to São Paulo. Gladstone and Ascânio invite everyone to a meeting. Bode of Bode threatens Perpetual.

videos.title: Chapter 197
videos.overview: Filó enters the meeting, accuses Trapizomba and asks Perpétua to confirm the story. At Mass for Arturzinho, Perpétua tells everyone that Tieta is Quenga.

videos.title: Chapter 198
videos.overview: Perpétua attacks Tieta, who tears off her wig. Tieta opens the tourist complex. Bafo de Bode opens his circus.
